typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Id as string,
		Meeting_Date__c as string,
		Start_Time__c as string,
		End_Time__c as string,
		Presenting_Agent__c as string,
		Attending_Agent_1__c as string,
		Status__c as string,
		Meeting_Type__c as string,
		Meeting_FormalInformal__c as string,
		Language__c as string,
		Maximum_Capacity__c as double,
		Meeting_Products__c as string,
		Facility__c as string,
		Note__c as string,
		LastModifiedDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['salesforce/ob_kpma_seminar_update*']) ~> source1
source1 select(mapColumn(
		MEETING_ID = Id,
		MEETING_DATE = Meeting_Date__c,
		MEETING_START_TIME = Start_Time__c,
		MEETING_END_TIME = End_Time__c,
		OWNING_AGENT = Presenting_Agent__c,
		ATTENDING_AGENT = Attending_Agent_1__c,
		STATUS = Status__c,
		MEETING_EVENT_TYPE = Meeting_Type__c,
		FORMAL_INFORMAL = Meeting_FormalInformal__c,
		LANGUAGE = Language__c,
		MAX_SEATING_CAPACITY = Maximum_Capacity__c,
		PRODUCTS = Meeting_Products__c,
		FACILITY_UID = Facility__c,
		MEETING_NOTES = Note__c,
		REJECT_REASON = LastModifiedDate
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('ob_kpma_seminar_update_', toString(currentUTC(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'), '.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sink1
